snippet.title: Fairy Circle - Official Beta Test Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Beta Test Announcement Trailer for Fairy Circle, a turn-based strategy card game developed by Play Hooky. Players will assume the role of the Forest Keeper to guard the home from an elusive force called the Gloom. Assemble bags of magical stones, solve spatial puzzles, and bring life back to the land in Fairy Circle, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Beta Test running from January 19 through January 23.

#FairyCircle #TurnBased #Strategy
